description: Linux x86_64 Portal native Vulkan slice: SDL3 Wayland and pure Vulkan renderer.

intent.support_scope: Native Linux Wayland pure Vulkan smoke; not four-platform or renderer parity acceptance
intent.packaging: Waf-installed local Linux runtime with separately supplied licensed Portal content

shader_pipeline.coverage: Observed scene static groups; every valid dynamic permutation in each group. Not a complete shipping shader library.
shader_pipeline.staging: portal_boot.py --shader-artifacts validates input and artifact hashes before copying into the private runtime

required_checks: Source architecture and changed-region style checks

evidence.note: Pins describe the selected reproducible host slice. Passing configure is not native graphics or product acceptance. Runtime evidence records actual GPU/driver, build/source identity, process results and artifacts separately. Performance/power budgets and other platform release gates remain open.
